Long, flowing silky hair in a deep crimson shade with straight-cut bangs and two long side-locks framing the face. Sharp, determined almond-shaped eyes in a matching vivid crimson shade. Appears as a mature late-teen with a slender, athletic build. Wears a traditional modified sailor-style outfit consisting of a short white blouse with a navy blue collar, a short pleated navy blue skirt, and a red bow tie. Signature details include two large, ornate mechanical rigging units floating behind the back, featuring grey metallic armor and large naval cannons.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
